sentences.en: Recently, I saw an attractive mature woman on the train.
sentences.zh: 最近，我在火车上遇到了一位很有魅力的成熟女性。

sentences.en: The Pirate Party could mature into a political driving force.

sentences.en: He became more mature with the passing of the years.
sentences.zh: 随着岁月的流逝，他变得更加成熟了。

senses.zh: 成熟的；到期的；充分发育的
